test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

They will publish the research findings in a scientific journal next month.

options.text: The research findings will be published in a scientific journal by them.
The research findings will be published in a scientific journal by them next month.
The research findings will have been published in a scientific journal by them next month.
The research findings will be being published in a scientific journal by them next month.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They will publish the research findings in a scientific journal next month."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the research findings" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will publish" to "will be published" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "next month" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The research findings will be published in a scientific journal by them next month."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"They will publish the research findings in a scientific journal next month." – This is the active voice version of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: **"The research findings will have been published by them in a scientific journal next month." – Incorrect tense (future perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The research findings will be being published in a scientific journal by them next month." – Incorrect use of future continuous passive.
